# Commands

> Every command the *Sonic Pi for VS Code* extension contributes, with its ID, when the Command Palette offers it and which menus show it, generated from `package.json` `contributes.commands`.

| Command | ID | Command Palette | Menus |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sonic Pi: Run | `sonicpi.run` | always | `editor/title`, `editor/title/run`, `editor/context` |
| Sonic Pi: Run Selection | `sonicpi.runSelection` | always | `editor/title/run`, `editor/context` |
| Sonic Pi: Stop | `sonicpi.stop` | always | `editor/title`, `editor/context` |
| Sonic Pi: Connect | `sonicpi.connect` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Disconnect | `sonicpi.disconnect` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Restart Daemon | `sonicpi.restartDaemon` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Open Examples | `sonicpi.openExamples` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Start Recording | `sonicpi.startRecording` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Stop Recording | `sonicpi.stopRecording` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Save Recording | `sonicpi.saveRecording` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Beautify Buffer | `sonicpi.beautify` | always | `editor/context` |
| Sonic Pi: Open Tutorial | `sonicpi.openTutorial` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Open Tutorial Chapter | `sonicpi.openTutorialChapter` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Language Reference | `sonicpi.openReference` | always | `view/title` |
| Sonic Pi: Open Example File | `sonicpi.openExampleFile` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Listen (Audio Stream) | `sonicpi.openAudioStream` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: New Loop File | `sonicpi.newLoop` | always | — |
| Sonic Pi: Open Log | `sonicpi.openLog` | always | — |
